# Preface {.unnumbered}

Best practices for software development (and other tasks!) with coding agents, drawn from two years of daily use.

The focus is largely on **terminal agents** that run in your shell against your local files, e.g.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code),
- [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex),
- [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli).

::: {.callout-important}
## Disclaimer
The content of this book is largely the personal opinion of the author.  It does not represent
the position of the NSF ASCEND Engine, Rallypoint One, or any other organization.

His experience is primarily with Anthropic Claude Code and to a lesser extent OpenAI Codex.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress
This website covers agentic coding at a snapshot in time (November 2026).  The tools are changing
at a rapid pace, so follow advice with caution.
:::
